g.text: read after next position and apply
and next position if more remain
entries on the current branch are always eligible.
assistant.thinking.completed is eligible only when the current
Session thinking value is true. Disabling hides stored thinking
without deleting it; re-enabling can reveal it again.
Items are sorted by entrySeq ascending.
There is no fixed snapshot watermark. Later persisted
entries may become eligible on a subsequent page.
nextPage null means no more persisted events at response time.
It does not mean the Session cannot append future events.
An invalid or expired page returns 400 INVALID_EVENT_LIST_QUERY.
Changing Session thinking also invalidates an old page because
the page is bound to the previous visibility state.
